# siteswap {.inverse .center-h .larger200}

## [3]{.larger250 .dark} {background-image="images/3.gif" background-size="33%" background-position="50% 80%" aria-label="A animated gif of juggling 3 balls in a cascade pattern"}

## [4]{.larger250 .dark} {background-image="images/4.gif" background-size="33%" background-position="50% 80%" aria-label="A animated gif of juggling 4 balls in a fountain pattern"}

## [423]{.larger250 .dark} {background-image="images/423.gif" background-size="33%" background-position="50% 80%" aria-label="A animated gif of juggling 3 balls in a 423 pattern"}

## 

```{r}
#| echo: false
library(jugglr)
ss423 <- siteswap("423")
ss432 <- siteswap("432")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-alt: "Timeline diagram of the 423 siteswap pattern, showing the throws and catches of three props over time. Each throw is shown as an arc, with the height of the arc corresponding to the throw value. The arcs are coloured according to which prop is being thrown."
timeline(ss423)
```

## 

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-alt: "Timeline diagram of the 432 siteswap pattern, showing collisions and props appearing over time."
timeline(ss432)
```
